<mxfile host="drawio" version="24.7.17"> <diagram id="monitoring-loop" name="Monitoring loop"> <mxGraphModel dx="1200" dy="900" grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="0" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1000" pageHeight="800" background="#FFFFFF" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="title" value="Monitoring: inputs, checks, results and retraining" style="text;html=0;fontSize=20;fontColor=#1A1A19;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontStyle=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="0" width="760" height="34" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="preds" value="prediction_table
rows from the score job
(batch delivery)" style="rounded=1;arcSize=10;html=0;fillColor=#F5F5F5;strokeColor=#666666;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="60" width="210" height="70" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="logs" value="Serving request logs
endpoint payload table
(enrolled endpoints)" style="rounded=1;arcSize=10;html=0;fillColor=#F5F5F5;strokeColor=#666666;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="270" y="60" width="210" height="70" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="labels" value="Delayed labels
monitoring_label_table +
result-available time column" style="rounded=1;arcSize=10;html=0;fillColor=#F5F5F5;strokeColor=#666666;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="520" y="60" width="210" height="70" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="reference" value="Saved training rows
in the model's MLflow run
(training reference)" style="rounded=1;arcSize=10;html=0;fillColor=#F5F5F5;strokeColor=#666666;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="770" y="60" width="210" height="70" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="monitor" value="monitoring job: monitor_model task
runs after a score run when monitoring is enabled,
and on an hourly UTC schedule (paused by default)" style="rounded=1;arcSize=10;html=0;fillColor=#FFF4E5;strokeColor=#D79B00;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="270" y="185" width="460" height="70" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="drift" value="Drift and data quality
current inputs vs the training
reference, per feature" style="rounded=1;arcSize=10;html=0;fillColor=#EAF7EE;strokeColor=#82B366;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="270" y="315" width="210" height="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="perf" value="Performance loss
labeled predictions vs a baseline
(default: training holdout);
policy is off by default" style="rounded=1;arcSize=10;html=0;fillColor=#EAF7EE;strokeColor=#82B366;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="520" y="315" width="210" height="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="store" value="Monitoring store {monitoring_catalog}.{monitoring_schema}
monitoring_results, model_inventory,
performance_actions, retraining_requests
and views such as monitoring_issues" style="rounded=1;arcSize=10;html=0;fillColor=#F5F5F5;strokeColor=#666666;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="270" y="450" width="460" height="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="dashboard" value="Shared dashboard
reads the store; optional
refresh_monitoring_dashboard" style="rounded=1;arcSize=10;html=0;fillColor=#F3E8FF;strokeColor=#9673A6;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="790" y="435" width="190" height="70" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="alert" value="SQL alert you create
over monitoring_issues
(not generated)" style="rounded=1;arcSize=10;html=0;fillColor=#F3E8FF;strokeColor=#9673A6;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;dashed=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="790" y="530" width="190" height="70" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="evaluate" value="evaluate_retraining task
drift: only with on_drift=retrain
performance: policy mode retrain
guards: cooldown, new labeled rows" style="rounded=1;arcSize=10;html=0;fillColor=#FFF4E5;strokeColor=#D79B00;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="510" y="600" width="240" height="90" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ready" value="trigger ready
and guards pass?" style="rhombus;html=0;fillColor=#EAF7EE;strokeColor=#82B366;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="280" y="585" width="170" height="120" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="train" value="train job
new candidate
(model lifecycle)" style="rounded=1;arcSize=10;html=0;fillColor=#FFF4E5;strokeColor=#D79B00;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="605" width="190" height="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="caption" value="Labels feed only the performance check.
